notes: Covers phase-06 Steps 8-13 directly against MediaUploadCoordinator/RawUploadClient/PendingMediaUploadDao/ReadAloudAdvanceButton, the phase's two primary test targets being RawUploadClient (no-auth-header requirement) and MediaUploadCoordinator (the presign->upload->complete state machine plus its two trigger sources). Key design decisions: (1) the happy-path outbox-submission test uses captureAny across all three named args of upsertAnswer and asserts captured has length 3 (i.e. called exactly once total), rather than a single literal-argument verify -- this is what actually rules out an earlier partial-state (e.g. 'uploading') call ever reaching the outbox, since a literal-arg verify alone would not have flagged an earlier, differently-shaped call. (2) The RawUploadClient no-auth-header tests do NOT assert `interceptors` is fully empty -- an initial draft did and failed, because a plain Dio() attaches its own internal ImplyContentTypeInterceptor by default (unrelated to auth); the tests were corrected to assert specifically that no AuthHeaderInterceptor/TokenRefreshInterceptor is present, which is the actual security property Step 9 cares about, plus a direct assertion (via a recording HttpClientAdapter mirroring auth_header_interceptor_test.dart's pattern) that no Authorization header is ever attached to the outgoing request -- this is caught and fixed during this same test-writing pass, not left in place as a known-broken assertion. (3) The expired-URL retry test starts the row already at `uploading` with a future (non-expired) uploadUrlExpiresAt specifically to isolate the failure-driven retry path from the proactive clock-check path (both exist per the phase's Risks section); a second test confirms a non-expiry-shaped failure (looksExpired=false) does NOT trigger a re-presign, verifying the heuristic is not applied indiscriminately. (4) The process-death test at the coordinator level (distinct from the DAO-level one) builds two full AppDatabase instances against the same NativeDatabase file, closes the first, and hands the second's real PendingMediaUploadDao directly to a fresh MediaUploadCoordinator -- confirming resumption calls completeUpload only (never requestPresign or putFile) and that the row is deleted after the outbox handoff. (5) The in-flight-guard regression test uses a Completer to hold requestPresign in flight while both attemptUpload and scanAll race for the same row, confirming presignCallCount stays at 1 -- directly targeting the _inFlightRows Set Cook added in the simplify pass. (6) Per the task instructions, the happy-path test intentionally does not assert any particular number of getRow calls, since the coordinator's copyWith-based internal state passing (the second simplify-pass fix) legitimately changed that count and is not itself a behavior worth pinning. (7) ReadAloudAdvanceButton is tested via MockCubit<ReadAloudState> (bloc_test) implementing ReadAloudCubit, mirroring task_advance_button_test.dart's mocked-SyncEngine/mocked-ExamAttemptBloc conventions -- confirms the button is disabled for null/uploading/completing/uploaded and enabled only at ready, with flushOne called exactly once per tap and never called at all while not-ready. task_type_dispatcher_test.dart was read but not duplicated, per instructions, since it already exercises the READ_ALOUD routing wiring Cook patched in. Full `flutter test` run across the whole repo (140 tests) passed with zero failures and zero skips. No production code was modified — only new test files (4 new files, 26 new tests) plus reading of existing conventions.
